text:
Marisa: SImple recap: our lease-swap sims show lost-in-flight writes when ownership flips mid-request. Proposal: proxy creates a tiny durable escrow record and becomes a delegate that replays to the eventual owner (durable delegate proxy). Pros/cons?

alex: Seems safe. Downside: tail latency + tiny local storage. We need idempotency to avoid double-apply.

marisa: Plan: signed write_token + shard_seq_span. Replay is at-least-once; target dedupes by token and validates seq span.

devon: Residency constraint: EU-only tenants must never leave region. Escrow must include residency_policy and proxy must enforce routing; otherwise quarantine.

marisa: If no allowed destination, mark escrow QUARANTINED and surface to ops UI.

sam: Durability worry: proxy crash during outage. Keep escrow small and sync-replicated in-region (replication=2) and ship metadata async to control plane. TTL short (default 180s).

nina: Add metrics: escrow_inflight, forward_latency_p95, quarantined_count, replay_failures. Traces should carry forward_attempt_id and write_token.

alex: Client contract: default non-blocking 202 + X-Write-Token. Background forwarder applies. Provide sync=true for callers needing strong commit, and status endpoint GET /escrow/{token}.

devon: SLOs: default completion p95 < 30s; page ops if >2m; quarantine after 5m. Forward_retry_limit = 5 with exp backoff.

sam: Ordering: include shard_seq_range so target can detect gaps and request gap-fetch before apply.

marisa: Handshake: forwarder POST /handoff with signed token; target validates signature & ownership. On mismatch return 409 + owner_hint. Retries bounded then escalate. Snippet: POST /handoff {"write_token":"wt-ff12","shard":"s-42","seq_span":[12345,12347],"residency":"eu"}

marisa: Tokens short-lived and signed by proxy key to prevent spoofing.

ops-bot: [automation] defaults: escrow_replication=2; default_ttl_secs=180; forward_retry_limit=5; quarantine_retention_days=14.

nina: Also audit every forward event (proxy-id, operator-id if manual, timestamps, outcome) and export for compliance.

marisa: Rollout: feature-flag -> dark-launch metrics -> canary for non-sovereign tenants -> extend to sovereign after legal signoff. Gate on escrow backlog and error rate.

alex: Implementation estimate: 4w core + 2w integration + runbook/legal parallel.

marisa: I'll open RFC patch with token spec, escrow contract, and rollout checklist. Prototype in staging for low-risk tenants first. Tagging @alex @devon @sam @nina.
